phrases.meaning_en: Combines “fake” (dishonest, inauthentic) with “bc”, which in Hindi/Hinglish online slang is shorthand for behenchod — a severe gendered insult.
phrases.offender_implication: Attacks the target’s credibility and character at once: implies they are a fraud or liar while using a vulgar slur to demean and provoke public shame.

phrases.meaning_en: “Fake” plus bsdk (bhosdi ke / son of a whore) — an extremely offensive Hindi slur compound.
phrases.offender_implication: Publicly brands the target as dishonest and hurls a dehumanizing insult meant to humiliate and draw hostile pile-on from others.
Questions the target’s authenticity while using a violent-family insult to maximize offense and social damage.

phrases.display: meet for sex / wanna meet for sex
phrases.meaning_en: Direct sexual solicitation in English (often obfuscated as S*X). Not a debate — an unwanted sexual proposition.
phrases.offender_implication: Treats the target as a sexual object, ignores consent and context, and may pressure or expose them to unwanted sexual attention in a public comment thread.
Pressures the target for sexual material; often used to harass, extort, or humiliate.

terms.meaning_en: In Hindi/Hinglish social media, “bc” usually means behenchod (literally “sister-f***er”) — a highly offensive swear used as an insult, not a literal family reference.
terms.offender_implication: Meant to shock, demean, and provoke; signals contempt and aggression rather than constructive criticism.

terms.meaning_en: Short for bhosdi ke (“son of a whore”) — among the strongest Hindi profanities used online.
terms.offender_implication: Deliberate dehumanization and public humiliation; often posted to invite ridicule or escalate conflict.

terms.meaning_en: Short for madarchod (“mother-f***er”) — a severe Hindi/Urdu slur.
terms.offender_implication: Expresses extreme hostility; used to intimidate, insult, or dominate in an argument.

terms.meaning_en: Vulgar Hindi insult implying stupidity or worthlessness (from chut — genital slang).
terms.offender_implication: Dismisses the target’s intelligence or dignity to silence or mock them.

terms.meaning_en: Hindi slur meaning “prostitute,” used to shame women (or anyone) with sexualized abuse.
terms.offender_implication: Sexualized degradation — attacks honour, gender, and safety; can escalate to coordinated harassment.

terms.meaning_en: Vulgar Hindi word for penis, used in insults or sexual harassment.
terms.offender_implication: Crude sexual aggression or emasculation — makes the space hostile and unsafe.

terms.meaning_en: “Your mother” / “your sister” — common setup for family-targeted threats or slurs in Hindi fights.
terms.offender_implication: Escalates to personal/family attack; often precedes or accompanies threats and severe slurs.

terms.meaning_en: References rape literally or as “balatkar” (Hindi). In comments, often used as threat or wish of harm.
terms.offender_implication: Creates fear of sexual violence; may be illegal threat speech and causes severe psychological harm.

terms.meaning_en: Direct or implied threat of physical harm (“I will kill you” / “mar dalunga”).
terms.offender_implication: Intimidation and fear — signals intent to harm or encourages violence.

terms.meaning_en: Accuses the target of being fraudulent, paid PR, or lying.
terms.offender_implication: Reputational attack to undermine trust, sponsorship, and audience — can damage livelihood.
